items.title: Knowledge Graph-Driven Expert-Level Reasoning for Neuroscience
items.title_zh: 知识图谱驱动的神经科学专家级推理
items.summary: The authors build a neuroscience knowledge graph from a single authoritative textbook via a dual-LLM validation pipeline, expand it with a masked LM, generate multi-hop QA with reasoning traces, and fine-tune a small LM on that supervision plus RL with path-derived rewards. They report expert-level mechanistic reasoning that surpasses larger LLMs while using orders of magnitude fewer parameters.

items.title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
items.title_zh: SkillsVote：从收集、推荐到演化的智能体技能生命周期治理
items.summary: SkillsVote is a lifecycle-governance framework that profiles a million-scale open-source corpus of agent skills, then collects, recommends and evolves reusable skills for long-horizon LLM agents. Its Hugging Face listing drew 79 upvotes and its code repository 306 stars.

items.title: EVE-Agent: Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agents
items.title_zh: EVE-Agent：证据可验证的自进化智能体
items.summary: EVE-Agent modifies the proposer-solver loop so each generated instance includes a verbatim evidence span, and an evidence verifier rewards spans by their marginal accuracy gain when provided. The approach substantially improves evidence-grounded correctness over prior self-evolving search agents while leaving the backbone, retriever and search tool unchanged.

items.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
items.title_zh: 通过自我调节的模拟式规划实现高效智能体推理
items.summary: CMU and MBZUAI researchers decompose agent reasoning into simulative planning, self-regulation and reactive execution to build SR²AM; the 30B version matches 685B-1T parameter systems while using 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens.

items.title: Auditing Agent Harness Safety
items.title_zh: 审查智能体执行框架的安全性
items.summary: HarnessAudit evaluates complete agent execution trajectories for boundary compliance, execution fidelity and system stability rather than final answers alone. Across ten harness configurations on a 210-task benchmark, it found task completion often diverges from safe execution and that multi-agent setups widen the risk surface.

items.title: Prompting language influences diagnostic reasoning and accuracy of large language models
items.title_zh: 提示语言影响大语言模型的诊断推理与准确性
items.summary: The study compared English and French prompting across five LLMs on 180 clinical vignettes covering 16 specialties, rated by two physicians. Four of five models performed better in English, with mean differences of 0.37-0.91 points, while o3 was the only model showing no overall language effect.

items.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis
items.title_zh: Code-as-Room：通过智能体代码合成从俯视图图像生成 3D 房间
items.summary: Code-as-Room is an MLLM agentic framework that converts top-down view images into executable Blender code through a structured execution harness with cross-stage memory, avoiding the looping seen in prior image-conditioned agents. Its Hugging Face listing drew 40 upvotes and its code repository 241 stars.

items.title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind
items.title_zh: OSCToM：面向高阶心理理论的强化学习引导对抗生成
items.summary: OSCToM generates observer-self belief conflicts using reinforcement learning, an extended domain-specific language and compositional surrogate models. OSCToM-8B reaches 76% accuracy on the information-asymmetric FANToM benchmark, compared with 0.2% reported by ExploreToM, and its data-synthesis procedure is 6x more efficient.

items.title: CASTLE: Contrastive and Seed-Guided Training for Cold-Start Natural Language Search
items.title_zh: CASTLE：面向冷启动自然语言搜索的对比与种子引导训练
items.summary: CASTLE generates synthetic queries and relevance labels from structured catalog data for Airbnb's natural language search, combining structure-guided prompting with seed queries and contrastive listing pairs derived from booking sessions. It reports a query-distribution KL of 1.01 versus real users, a 9.2x improvement over the best baseline, and 91-93% human agreement with its labels.

items.title: PACE: Two-Timescale Self-Evolution for Small Language Model Agents
items.title_zh: PACE：面向小语言模型智能体的双时间尺度自进化
items.summary: PACE coordinates low-risk prompt refinement with higher-risk control-logic updates, evolving prompts until gains saturate and then accepting constrained logic changes through held-out validation. Across three frozen 4B-14B backbones and four benchmarks it improved over vanilla SLM agents by up to 9.2% relative and led all 12 backbone-benchmark combinations.

items.title: Beyond Final Answers: Auditing Trajectory-Level Hallucinations in Multi-Agent Industrial Workflows
items.title_zh: 超越最终答案：审计多智能体工业工作流中的轨迹级幻觉
items.summary: Trajel is a dataset and evaluation framework with a five-type hallucination taxonomy over expert-annotated agent traces from AssetOpsBench, covering factual, referential, logical, procedural and scope-based failures. The authors report that nearly half of hallucinated trajectories involve multiple types at once and that trajectory-aware detection significantly outperforms standard post-hoc verification.

items.title: How Well Do Models Follow Their Constitutions?
items.title_zh: 模型对其行为宪章的遵循程度如何？
items.summary: The authors present a multi-method audit that decomposes Anthropic's constitution into 205 testable tenets and OpenAI's Model Spec into 197, then probes seven models per specification with multi-turn adversarial scenarios. Violation rates fell from 15.0% for Claude Sonnet 4 to 2.0% for Sonnet 4.6 and from 11.7% for GPT-4o to 3.6% for GPT-5.2, though the authors cannot isolate whether the gains come from specification-specific training, broader post-training or evaluation awareness.

items.title: CP-Agent: A Calibrated Risk-Controlled Agent for Feedback-Driven Competitive Programming
items.title_zh: CP-Agent：面向反馈驱动竞赛编程的校准风险受控智能体
items.summary: CP-Agent models feedback-driven competitive programming as a calibrated stopped process and instantiates dual-granularity verification, test augmentation and experience-driven self-evolution. Without updating model parameters it raises Pass@1 from 25.8% to 48.5% on LiveCodeBench Pro and improves Refine@5 by 11.0% on ICPC-Eval across three backbones.

items.title: RAGe: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: RAGe：检索增强生成评估框架
items.summary: RAGe is a modular framework for benchmarking RAG applications that correlates retrieval and generation quality with hardware constraints while recommending pipeline components for a domain-specific dataset. It evaluates document chunking, vector databases, embedding models and retrievers across accuracy, efficiency and scalability trade-offs, including on consumer-grade hardware.

items.title: Specification-Based Code-Text-Code Reengineering for LLM-Mediated Software Evolution
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 驱动软件演化的基于规范的代码-文本-代码重构
items.summary: The paper proposes a specification-based Code2Text2Code framework that converts source code into a neutral textual specification capturing behavior, identifiers, control flow, side effects and domain intent before regenerating target code. It combines factual context extraction, iterative source-spec verification, retrieval-augmented grounding, semantic-aware chunking and graph-based transformation-loss estimation.

items.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
items.title_zh: CiteVQA：为可信文档智能建立证据归因基准
items.summary: CiteVQA contains 1,897 questions over 711 PDFs that require document models to return element-level bounding-box citations alongside each answer. Auditing 20 multimodal LLMs exposed widespread attribution hallucination, with the best system, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, reaching 76.0 strict attributed accuracy.

items.title: ReacTOD: Bounded Neuro-Symbolic Agentic NLU for Zero-Shot Dialogue State Tracking
items.title_zh: ReacTOD：面向零样本对话状态跟踪的有界神经符号智能体 NLU
items.summary: ReacTOD reformulates natural-language understanding as discrete tool calls inside a bounded, self-correcting ReAct loop, with a symbolic validator enforcing action compliance, schema conformance and coreference consistency. On MultiWOZ 2.1, gpt-oss-20B reached 52.71% joint goal accuracy, 14 points above the previous zero-shot best.

items.title: Code as Agent Harness
items.title_zh: 代码即智能体运行框架
items.summary: This survey frames code as the operational substrate for agent reasoning, action, environment modeling and execution-based verification, organized around the harness interface, harness mechanisms and multi-agent scaling. Its Hugging Face listing drew 225 upvotes and its companion repository 721 stars.

items.title: TOBench: A Task-Oriented Omni-Modal Benchmark for Real-World Tool-Using Agents
items.title_zh: TOBench：面向真实工具使用智能体的任务导向全模态基准
items.summary: The Pi3AI paper introduces a task-oriented omni-modal tool-use benchmark and evaluation harness with 100 executable tasks across customer service and intelligent creation, including closed-loop verification of intermediate artifacts. Its Hugging Face listing had 9 upvotes and its code repository 5 stars.

items.title: Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems
items.title_zh: 以成功目标为单位的智能体 AI 能耗核算
items.summary: The paper proposes Energy per Successful Goal, dividing total workflow energy including failures and retries by successfully completed goals, plus an Orchestration Overhead Index comparing agentic with linear execution. Across nine task families, including GPU dynamic energy widened the measured overhead range to 0.4x-26.48x, showing that CPU-only measurement understates agentic costs.

items.title: Mem-π: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
items.title_zh: Mem-π：通过学习“何时生成、生成什么”实现自适应记忆
items.summary: Mem-π replaces retrieval-based memory for LLM agents with a separate model that decides both when to generate guidance and what to generate, trained with decision-content decoupled reinforcement learning. It reports over 30% relative gains on web navigation.

items.title: Bayesian Rational Search Engine User
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯理性的搜索引擎用户
items.summary: The paper models a user who decides whether to inspect another search result or stop, where each inspection both yields a candidate and updates beliefs about the remaining page. It shows the optimal policy is a depth-dependent standout rule, derives a closed-form distribution of inspection depth, and applies the resulting likelihood to public Baidu search logs.

items.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
items.title_zh: 全注意力反击：百步训练内将全注意力转为稀疏注意力
items.summary: RTPurbo exploits intrinsic sparsity in full-attention LLMs by keeping the full KV cache only for retrieval heads and adding a 16-dimensional token indexer; a few hundred training steps yield up to 9.36x prefill speedup at 1M context with near-lossless accuracy.

items.title: Benchmarking the Personalization Capabilities of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型个性化能力基准评测
items.summary: The authors introduce SDR-Arena and SDR-Bench, a corpus of 50,000 customer success stories across 22 industries and 3,500 enterprises, to test two-party personalization where an agent reconstructs the arguments that won a deal. The best model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, reaches 55.8% weighted nugget recall, and an ablation shows the bottleneck is retrieval rather than reasoning.

items.title: PRIMA: Operational Patterns for Resilient Multi-Agent Research with Verifiable Identity and Convergent Feedback
items.title_zh: PRIMA：具备可验证身份与收敛反馈的弹性多智能体研究运行模式
items.summary: PRIMA presents three operational patterns for multi-hour multi-agent research runs: a resilience layer that persists typed pause records and resumes without redoing converged work, a sub-agent discipline for task fidelity and tool use, and a multi-phase drafting pattern with cross-document harmonization. Agent identities derive from prime powers, giving collision-free identifiers and O(k) verification.

items.title: Inference Time Optimization with Confidence Dynamics
items.title_zh: 基于置信度动态的推理时优化
items.summary: The paper observes that correct reasoning traces tend to show rising confidence over the trajectory while incorrect traces show flat or declining confidence, and proposes Confidence Dynamic Gain voting that incorporates the confidence trajectory. Across DeepSeek-R1, gpt-oss, Gemma-3 and Qwen-QwQ on AIME24/25, HMMT25 and BRUMO25, CDG improves answer selection over baselines.

items.title: STREAM: A Data-Centric Framework for Mining High-Value Task-Oriented Dialogues from Streaming Media
items.title_zh: STREAM：从流媒体中挖掘高价值任务型对话的数据中心框架
items.summary: STREAM synthesizes service dialogues from public live streams and short videos by mining interaction signals, building role-grounded personas and conversational blueprints, and using RAG for knowledge-aware responses. It releases StreamDial, 87,498 sessions and 1,497,320 turns across automotive, restaurant and hotel domains, and reports improved dialogue quality and dialogue state tracking.

items.title: Doorman11991/smallcode
items.title_zh: Doorman11991/smallcode：为小参数模型优化的 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: smallcode is a JavaScript AI coding agent optimized for small language models, claiming 87% on an unspecified benchmark with a 4B-active-parameter model. It had 2,028 GitHub stars and 153 forks.

items.title: open-mercato/cezar
items.title_zh: open-mercato/cezar：并行运行多种 AI 编程智能体的编排器
items.summary: cezar is an open-source TypeScript orchestrator and agent development environment for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and other AI coding agents in parallel, either locally or continuously on a user's own server. It had 835 stars and 156 forks.

items.title: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform
items.title_zh: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform：企业多智能体 IT 运维平台
items.summary: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform is a TypeScript project billed as China's first enterprise multi-agent IT operations platform, using LLMs for automated remediation on Zabbix and Prometheus with Docker deployment. It had 945 stars and 231 forks.

items.title: EverMind-AI/Raven
items.title_zh: EverMind-AI/Raven：面向递归自我改进的持久自进化多智能体生态
items.summary: EverMind-AI's Raven is a Python project billed as a harness of harnesses built for recursive self-improvement, described as a persistent self-evolving multi-agent ecosystem. It had 5,822 stars and 213 forks on GitHub.

items.title: Launch HN: Superset (YC P26) – IDE for the agents era
items.title_zh: Superset：面向智能体时代的 IDE
items.summary: Superset is an open-source agentic IDE from a YC P26 team for running coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in parallel on isolated git worktrees; its Launch HN post drew 108 points and 135 comments.

items.title: ongridio/ongrid
items.title_zh: ongrid：能定位并修复基础设施故障的运维 AI Agent
items.summary: ongrid is a Go-based ops AI agent with 1,223 stars and 272 forks that understands infrastructure, finds root causes and fixes them from Slack, Telegram, Lark or DingTalk.

items.title: termio-sh/termio
items.title_zh: termio：终端优先的智能体开发环境
items.summary: termio is a Swift project with 584 stars and 44 forks offering a terminal-first agentic development environment for CLI and TUI coding agents, pitched as a runtime and a tmux alternative for coding agents.

items.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Dell 合作将 Codex 带入混合与本地企业环境
items.summary: OpenAI and Dell announced a partnership to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise environments, aimed at helping enterprises deploy AI coding agents securely across their data and workflows.

items.title: Reverse engineering Android malware from popular Chinese projectors
items.title_zh: 用自主编程智能体逆向分析中国产热门投影仪中的 Android 恶意软件
items.summary: A blogger pointed an autonomous coding agent at a $35 Chinese-made projector and reverse-engineered the Android malware it found, including a large remote access trojan. The post drew 89 points and 19 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Gemini CLI will stop working from June 18, 2026
items.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将于 2026 年 6 月 18 日起停止工作
items.summary: Google announced that Gemini CLI will be sunset in favor of Antigravity CLI, described as a more robust, agent-first platform built for the multi-agent complexity of 2026. The change takes effect June 18, 2026; the Hacker News post drew 406 points and 209 comments.

items.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
items.title_zh: Show HN：Forge —— 护栏把 8B 模型在智能体任务上的成绩从 53% 提升到 99%
items.summary: Antoine Zambelli released Forge, an open-source reliability layer for self-hosted LLM tool calling that adds retry nudges, step enforcement and VRAM-aware context management. It reportedly lifts an 8B model from about 53% to 99% on multi-step agentic workflows; the Show HN post drew 687 points and 252 comments.

items.title: Qwen3.7-Max: The Agent Frontier
items.title_zh: Qwen3.7-Max：智能体新前沿
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.7-Max, billed as "The Agent Frontier", with a post listing chatbot, image and video understanding and generation, document processing and tool use. The release drew 721 points and 290 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: How Virgin Atlantic ships faster with Codex
items.title_zh: 维珍航空如何借助 Codex 加速交付
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Virgin Atlantic used Codex to rebuild its mobile app against a fixed holiday travel deadline, reaching near-total unit test coverage and zero P1 defects.
